experiment.name: commuted_pointer_addition_expression
experiment.hypothesis: Writing the defined pointer addition as entry_index + entry may preserve the integer-index operand as the first indexed-load input and select retail lwzx r4,r8,r4 without changing lifetime or adding an instruction.
experiment.compiler_argv: tools/mwcc_wrapper.py build/tools/sjiswrap.exe compilers/GC/1.3/mwcceppc.exe -nodefaults -proc gekko -align powerpc -enum int -fp hardware -Cpp_exceptions off -O4,p -inline auto -pragma cats off -pragma warn_notinlined off -maxerrors 1 -nosyspath -RTTI off -fp_contract on -str reuse -multibyte -i include -i build/GEDE01/include -DVERSION_GEDE01 -DNDEBUG=1 -lang=c -MMD -c src/game/game_fn_801247F8.c -o build/GEDE01/src/game
